name: Wedding Bed
description: In the early days of the Republic of China, the Zhang family in Zhejiang was very wealthy. There was a young lady in the family who regarded her as a treasure since childhood. When she was about to get married, her family spent a lot of money and hired skilled craftsmen to build a luxurious wedding bed as a dowry. The bed took one thousand man-hours to complete, hence the name Qiangong Bed. Its workmanship is exquisite, complex yet ingenious, luxurious yet elegant, with vermilion wood carvings, mother-of-pearl inlays, mismatched gold engravings, and grandeur. This incident became a legend, and later generations followed suit, giving wedding beds to the newlyweds and wishing them happiness and happiness.
